voice.name: Open Sector - Xenomorph Drone
voice.note: Shares the Xenomorph Drone voice (voices/xenodrone.json): no new custom voice. Calmer, softer delivery for the unarmed mender. It carries no gun, so its attack lines turn the order down (a right-click on an enemy still sends cmd.attack).
voice.description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.

attack: We do not unmake. We mend.

mend.prompt: Soft sci-fi nanite repair pulse: a gentle shimmering swarm hum swelling up, a soft bright glassy chime-like energy pulse rippling outward, tiny glittering clicks of microscopic machines, fading out smoothly, calm and soothing, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Steady rhythmic walking footsteps of a light robot soldier, left right left right, eight quick light metal footfalls on gravel spread evenly over two seconds with a soft shimmering nanite hum underneath, close, no music, no voice
